question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Final query
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
  WHERE sales_q4_2019 > 0
    AND 1.0 * (sales_q4_2020 - sales_q4_2019) / sales_q4_2019 >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as prod_sales_q4_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as prod_sales_q4_2020,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_sales_q4_2019, prod_sales_q4_2020, total_sales,
    1.0 * prod_sales_q4_2019 / SUM(prod_sales_q4_2019) OVER () as share_q4_2019,
    1.0 * prod_sales_q4_2020 / SUM(prod_sales_q4_2020) OVER () as share_q4_2020
  FROM product_sales
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_sales_q4_2019, prod_sales_q4_2020, total_sales,
    share_q4_2019, share_q4_2020,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as percentile_bucket
  FROM product_shares
),
top_20pct AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE percentile_bucket = 1
)
SELECT prod_id,
  (share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019) * 100 as pct_point_change
FROM top_20pct
ORDER BY ABS((share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019) * 100) ASC
LIMIT 1
